# Ghazali Handicrafts

> Authentic Pakistani Artisanal Heritage & Master Craft Studio established in 1976 in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Brand Overview
- Flagship Address: 27 New Anarkali Road, Anarkali Bazaar, Lahore, Punjab 54000, Pakistan.
- Google Maps Location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/7sGBoDgCb1imyGME8
- Operating History: 50 continuous years operating from the historic Anarkali Bazaar artisan hub.
- Logistics: 100% Cash on Delivery nationwide across Pakistan with double-crated wooden fragile protection.
- WhatsApp Concierge: +92 310 4755973
- Official Website: https://www.ghazalihandicrafts.com

## Core Heritage Specializations
1. Multani Blue Pottery (Kashigari): Hand-thrown white quartz ceramics with cobalt/turquoise glazes.
2. Swati Walnut Woodwork: Generational deep relief-carved trays, bridal boxes, and decorative tables.
3. Pakistani Truck Art: Authentic hand-painted enamels, reflective chamka sticker work, and kettles.
4. Taxila Marble & Onyx: Hand-turned translucent sailboat desk clocks and mortar/pestles.
5. Khewra Amber Salt: Natural Himalayan raw rock crystal lamps with wooden bases.
